artifact: P05-02 ENTITLEMENT AND CREDENTIAL / SECRETS-FLOW CONTRACT SURFACE

classification.trackerP05_02ExitCriteria: UNMET — "Authenticated ingestion works" requires live execution (D9 N-1)

separationOfConcerns: P02 E-1 — credentials and secrets are P03. P05-02 defines only THAT an entitlement decision occurs and HOW its outcome is represented.

entitlement.defaultDeny: EV-3 — absent, expired, UNKNOWN or unevaluable DENIES.
entitlement.failClosed: EV-4 — a denial yields no data, no partial data, no cached substitute.
entitlement.neverInferredFromResponse: EV-7 — a provider erroneously serving unentitled data does not create entitlement.

evaluations.reason: DENIED → fail closed, no data, no partial data, no cached substitute (EV-4)
PARTIAL → entitled fields plus explicit WITHHELD markers (EV-8, RD-1)

entitlement.partialEntitlement: EV-8 / RD-1 — entitled fields plus explicit WITHHELD markers carrying an entitlementRef. WITHHELD is never conflated with NOT_PROVIDED.
entitlement.entitlementMatrixStatus: EMPTY (EM-2). Populating it requires provider selection (no authority recorded) and licensing (P16) — EM-3.

credential.rule: SP-5 — an entitlement record references a credential REQUIREMENT, never a credential.

measuredScannerBlindSpot.finding: The P05-01 regex scanner detects credential material in SOURCE-ASSIGNMENT form (key = "value") but NOT in SERIALIZED-JSON form ({"key":"value"}), because a quote sits between the key and the colon. A regex over text cannot see structure.
measuredScannerBlindSpot.whyLA20Exists: LA-20 adds a STRUCTURAL walk over keys and values, which catches the JSON form. The two checks are complementary; neither alone is sufficient.
measuredScannerBlindSpot.disposition: OPEN — BD-P05-02-06. Repairing the P05-01 scanner is out of P05-02 scope.
